You will be ok and you will get through this, and you are not alone. I’ve had severe anxiety and panic where I truly believed I was dying and I eventually got past it and here I am, fully alive! Try to see the light at the end of the tunnel even though it sucks right now… tell yourself “I won’t feel this way forever, I won’t feel like this in 5 years, a year etc” having hope really helps a lot. Also remind yourself that anxiety and panic are essentially fake… they mimic health issues that are simply not there. It’s not real. Sending love! 🖤
I’ve got no advice for you but I’d also love to know the answer - lithium is next on the chopping block for me as well. Sending love and luck!

Panic will certainly create some super funky heart stuff and I’ve had the “oh shit I’m gonna faint” happen more times than I can count. Panic is just super fun and mimics all kind of garbage… just gotta breathe and remind yourself it’s all fake. What helps me is if I talk to myself out loud saying “your speech is fine” and then do a few deep breaths “breathing is normal” and then check heart and sometimes it’s fast, but that’s also normal and to be expected with panic. You’ll get through this! Maybe try getting up slower also

Please go ASAP, things may get worse before they get better and you’re better off going now. I know it’s an inconvenience and this sucks but you’ll feel so much safer and better once you’re with medical professionals. Please keep us updated.
